case_title.quote: SUNIL DAMODAR GAIKWAD v. STATE OF MAHARASHTRA

number_of_accused.quote: The appellant was prosecuted for causing the death of his wife and two sons
number_of_accused.reason: A single appellant is tried and sentenced.

accused_gender.quote: The appellant was married to a woman named Sangita.
accused_gender.reason: Accused is a husband and father, referred to as 'he'.

accused_age.reason: The judgment gives no age for the accused.

accused_caste.reason: No caste or community is mentioned.

accused_occupation.quote: He was a tailor by profession and employed as such in a cloth shop.

accused_socioeconomic_status.quote: appellant suffered from economic and psychic compulsions ... abject poverty
accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: Poverty is stated and accepted by the Court.

previous_criminal_record.quote: The accused had no prior criminal record.

victim_gender.quote: his wife Sangita and his two sons ... his daughter Gaitri
victim_gender.reason: Victims are a woman, two boys and a girl, so mixed.

accused_victim_relationship.quote: he assaulted his wife Sangita and his two sons ... On his daughter Gaitri
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Husband and father of the victims.

offence_category.quote: convicted him under both Sections [302 and 307]
offence_category.reason: Murder is the main offence, with an attempt count alongside.

statutory_provisions.quote: faced trial under Section 302 read with Section 307 of IPC
statutory_provisions.reason: IPC ss.302 and 307 are the sections involved.

weapon.quote: separated parts of a pair of sharp scissors

evidence_type.quote: FSL report has confirmed that the blood on the clothes of the appellant ... was of the same group
evidence_type.reason: Eyewitness, medical, FSL, recovery and police-statement evidence are all described.

confession.quote: the statement made by the appellant himself before the police on the basis of which the FIR was registered
confession.reason: The Court quotes the police statement and uses it for intent and change of heart.

aggravating_circumstances.quote: The Sessions Court and the High Court are of the view that the case falls under the rarest of the rare category
aggravating_circumstances.reason: Facts of the killings and the lower courts' view are accurately noted.

mitigating_circumstances.quote: The possibility of reforming and rehabilitating the accused cannot be ruled out.
mitigating_circumstances.reason: Matches the factors the Court noted.

trial_court_outcome.quote: Under Section 302, he was sentenced to death and under Section 307, to life imprisonment.

high_court_outcome.quote: the High Court confirmed the death sentence. The appeal ... was dismissed

final_outcome.quote: while upholding the conviction ... we modify the sentence

offence_finally_established.quote: upholding the conviction of the appellant under Section 302 and Section 307 of IPC

imprisonment_type.quote: For offence under Section 302 of IPC, the appellant is sentenced to life imprisonment.
imprisonment_type.reason: Life imprisonment is the main sentence.

imprisonment_years.quote: sentenced ... to imprisonment for a period of seven years
imprisonment_years.reason: Seven years under s.307 is the fixed term.

neutral_facts.quote: he assaulted his wife Sangita and his two sons with the separated parts of a pair of sharp scissors
neutral_facts.reason: Accurate, anonymised, and gives no outcome.

offence_severity.quote: life imprisonment for murder is the rule and capital sentence the exception
offence_severity.reason: Death or life for murder is supported; s.307 penalty is not stated.

attempt_completion.quote: the child did not succumb to death

physical_harm.quote: I was assaulted over my chest and abdomen and to my both hands.

number_of_offences.reason: Two sections charged and both upheld.

premeditation_planning.quote: The appellant had in fact intended to wipe out the whole family including himself
premeditation_planning.reason: The Court accepted the intent but made no explicit premeditation finding.

motive.quote: The appellant's income was hardly sufficient to maintain his family and he was under stress

key_evidence_accepted.quote: the evidence available on record ... would establish beyond doubt that accused alone was involved

witness_credibility.quote: Gaitri alias Pooja was clear and consistent during the investigation as well as before the Sessions Court.

post_offence_conduct.quote: bolted the door from outside and went straight to the police station and reported the incident

trial_duration.quote: On 08.07.2008 ... dated 23.09.2010 of the High Court
trial_duration.reason: Dates match; trial judgment date not given.

legal_representation.quote: Ramesh Chandra Mishra, Dr. Meera Agarwal for the Appellant. Sushil Karanjkar, Asha Gopalan Nair for the Respondent.

investigation_status.quote: An FIR was registered. His statement was recorded.

appeal_history.quote: On reference, the High Court confirmed the death sentence.

defence_argument.quote: the learned counsel appearing for the appellant was mainly canvassing for commuting the death sentence
defence_argument.reason: Commutation was the main plea; non-involvement contention is also noted.

legal_principle_applied.quote: the court has to first examine whether it is a case fit for awarding of life sentence

precedent_relied_upon.quote: Bachan Singh vs. State of Punjab ... Machhi Singh ... Shankar Kisanrao Khade

sentencing_rationale.quote: does not fall under the rarest of rare category

judicial_mitigating_factors.quote: The possibility of reforming and rehabilitating the accused cannot be ruled out.

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: The Court itself weighed no aggravating factors.

other_sentence_order.quote: the sentence of imprisonment under Section 307 of IPC shall commence thereafter
